compliance_statuses.REVIEW_REQUIRED: Jurisdiction allows commercial contact under specific conditions (e.g. US CAN-SPAM or UK PECR corporate subscriber legitimate interest), but message relevance, corporate entity type, and opt-out mechanics must be human-verified before outreach.
compliance_statuses.RESTRICTED: High-risk jurisdiction (e.g. Germany UWG §7, Austria, Italy) requiring prior explicit opt-in consent for commercial email, or consumer/personal email address detected. Outreach strictly prohibited without proof of prior consent.
compliance_statuses.ELIGIBILITY_NOT_ESTABLISHED: Insufficient evidence to determine legal registration jurisdiction, corporate subscriber status, or professional relevance. Must establish legal eligibility before proceeding.
compliance_statuses.OPT_OUT_RECORDED: Domain, email address, or individual is listed on the suppression list or has previously requested exclusion. Do not contact under any circumstances.

requirements: Human review required before outreach
Clear and conspicuous identification of commercial nature
Valid physical postal address in email footer
Functional, honored opt-out / unsubscribe mechanism within 10 days
No deceptive subject lines or spoofed headers
Verify corporate subscriber status (limited company, LLP, Scottish partnership); sole traders and traditional partnerships have consumer protections
Establish Legitimate Interest: service must be directly relevant to the recipient's commercial function
Easy, immediate opt-out mechanism mandatory in every communication
Public listing does not constitute blanket marketing consent
Conspicuous publication exemption applies ONLY if publication was without 'no unsolicited messages' statement
Message must be strictly and directly relevant to recipient's business/professional role
Must verify sender identification, postal address, and functional 60-day unsubscribe link
Cautious approach required: CASL carries statutory damages
Inferred consent via conspicuous publication requires message to be directly related to the person's employment or business role
Recipient must not have stated they do not want commercial electronic messages
Functional unsubscribe mechanism and accurate sender identification mandatory

DE.framework: German Act Against Unfair Competition (UWG §7 Abs. 2 Nr. 2)
requirements: Strict prohibition of cold commercial email without prior express opt-in consent (even for B2B)
No legitimate interest loophole for unsolicited cold email
Manual review required: outreach restricted unless prior business relationship exists
Prior consent mandatory for electronic commercial communications to businesses and consumers alike
Manual review required: restricted

FR.framework: French Postal and Electronic Communications Code (CPCE L.34-5) & CNIL guidelines
requirements: B2B cold email permitted without prior consent IF directly related to recipient's profession
Recipient must be informed of processing and given right to object / opt out easily at collection and in each email
B2B commercial messages permitted to corporate entities and business email addresses
Must state identity clearly and provide direct opt-out
Varies by member state; default to REVIEW_REQUIRED
Verify professional relevance and corporate subscriber status before any contact
